query: Republican voters Trump support latest poll

results.content:
Trump still maintains strong support among Republicans, but the poll suggests that support isn't as solid as it once was.

Seventy-five percent of Republicans currently approve of his job performance. That's down from 89 percent in April 2025 — a 14-point decline. Approval among people who voted for Trump in 2024 has also fallen over the longer term, dropping from 87 percent in April 2025 to 77 percent today. [...] The UMass survey doesn't measure which party voters currently plan to support for Congress, so it can't tell us who is ahead in the midterm race. But it does offer a snapshot of the political environment Republicans will be running in: A president with a 32 percent approval rating
results.title: A New Poll Has Some Warning Signs for Trump Ahead of the Midterms

The poll suggests that independent voters favour Democrats over Republicans when asked which party they would support in a congressional election held today. Among independents, 33 percent said they would vote for a Democrat, compared with 19 percent who said they would choose a Republican.

The Reuters/Ipsos survey questioned 1,215 adults across the United States over four days and has a margin of error of 3 percentage points in either direction.
